title: Domains
intro: Mail App gets email for these domains. Mailboxes and extra addresses can be at any of them.

kindHelp.main: The domain Mail App was installed on. It can't be removed.
kindHelp.added: A domain added later from this page.

removeConfirm: Take {domain} off Mail App? Its Cloudflare settings stay as they are, and you can add it again any time.
failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
setUpNote: To add a domain, first add it to your Cloudflare account, switch on Email Routing for it and add a catch-all rule that sends to this Worker. The README on GitHub shows how.
addHelp: Type one or more domains, separated by spaces or commas. Each one must already be in your Cloudflare account, with Email Routing on and a catch-all rule that sends to this Worker.
notReady: Not added yet: {domains}. Its mail doesn't reach Cloudflare yet. Switch on Email Routing for it in Cloudflare, then try again.
